subject: feat(scripts,posts): link checker v3.0, CI/CD pipelines post, preview image enhancements
body:
Link Health Guardian v3.0 rewrite:
- Dual engine: lychee (primary) or curl (fallback)
- Persistent .lycheecache for cross-run URL caching
- Incremental --changed-only mode for fast PR checks
- Delta-only AI analysis with multi-provider support (OpenAI/Anthropic)
- Declarative .lychee.toml configuration
- Simplified GitHub Actions workflow with PR trigger

New content:
- Blog post on CI/CD pipelines for VS Code extensions with GitHub Actions

Preview image improvements:
- Plugin rejects non-path preview values (text descriptions)
- Multi-candidate path checking for absolute/relative paths
- Script gains --enhance mode for AI image improvement

Other:
- Updated scripts/README.md for v3.0 docs
- Cleaned up oversized link-check-results data
- Deprecated guardian.sh in favor of link-checker.py --engine curl
- Updated CHANGELOG.md

author: copilot-swe-agent[bot]
subject: fix(ci): run bundle install before bundle-audit to prevent false-positive security alerts
body:
Without a committed Gemfile.lock (it is gitignored), bundle-audit check
exits non-zero with "Could not find Gemfile.lock", incorrectly setting
security_issues=true and triggering automated issue creation.

Fix: move `bundle install` before the `gem install bundler-audit` /
`bundle-audit check` steps so the lock file always exists when the audit
runs. Only real advisory-database hits will now flag security issues.
